title: Normal × Banyan Sapling
tagline: Before agents act, check the evidence.

scenes.label: THE QUESTION
scenes.narration: What happens when an AI stops giving advice and starts spending your money? This is Normal, and this is how Mubit's Banyan Sapling keeps it honest.
scenes.caption: What if the AI gets the diagnosis wrong?

scenes.label: AGENTS THAT ACT
scenes.narration: Normal runs an online shop with AI agents. When sales drop, it diagnoses why, then marketing, customer care and storefront agents act: cutting ad budgets, emailing customers, changing the store.
scenes.caption: Diagnosis → plan → merchant approval → agent action

scenes.label: THE POLICY GATE
scenes.narration: Every one of those actions trusts the diagnosis. So before any plan exists, we hand Sapling three things: the merchant's own policy, the evidence the AI cited, and the AI's claim. Sapling's verdict decides whether the plan can proceed.
scenes.caption: Merchant policy + cited evidence + AI claim → Sapling verdict

scenes.label: SUPPORTED RUN
scenes.narration: Live run. Fourteen orders missed their delivery promise. The policy needs at least ten. Sapling: supported. The plan goes to the merchant for approval.
scenes.caption: 14 late orders · at least 10 required · supported

scenes.label: BLOCKED RUN
scenes.narration: Now change one number. Only eight late orders. Same policy, same AI. Sapling flags a violation. The plan is blocked, the button locks, and no money moves.
scenes.caption: 8 late orders · below the threshold · plan blocked

scenes.label: FOUR LIVE CHECKS
scenes.narration: And it's not just thresholds. Four live checks at once. Evidence that clears the rule: supported. Evidence that misses it: violation. Evidence about ads, not deliveries: insufficient information. Evidence that contradicts itself: inconsistent. Four outcomes, one policy gate.
scenes.caption: Supported · violation · insufficient information · inconsistent context

scenes.label: EVIDENCE BEFORE ACTION
scenes.narration: The check runs again on the server, so a faked pass in the browser gets a four-oh-nine. Evidence first, policy checked, and a human approves every plan that passes. That's Normal, with Banyan Sapling.
scenes.caption: Evidence first. Policy checked. Human approved.
